name: Kiran Print Pack Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Kiran Print Pack Ltd is in the printing and packaging business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KPPL started its business from trading in paper and subsequently started printing activity and distribution of capital issue stationery. It then expanded and modernized the facilities and started printing public issue stationery, post issue stationery, publicity materials, corporate brochures, and label printing for industrial 
use.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.42 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.81% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.33% over last 3 years.
